reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Duties of the state council on the arts
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 including lead-in and subdivisions (1)-(4) plus 1965/1993 history note. Sets out council duties to stimulate performing and fine arts study and presentation, survey artistic and cultural institutions and make recommendations, expand cultural heritage interest and resources, and support freedom of artistic expression.

headings.title: Recognition of china painting as a fine art
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 text and 1993 H.B. 866 history note. Declares china painting, defined as the overglaze decoration of china, to be a fine art.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 185.040 (subsections 1-2 and subdivisions (1)-(4)) and 1965/1993 history note; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked council duties across subdivisions (1)-(4) and general assembly recognition of china painting as a fine art. Retained both drafted titles.

headings.title: Establishment of Missouri Historical Theater designation
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 text and 2019 history note. Establishes the 'Missouri Historical Theater' designation.

headings.title: Definitions of council and theater
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 including lead-in and subdivisions (1)-(2) plus 2019 history note. Defines 'Missouri state council on the arts'/'council' (citing section 185.010) and 'theater' (a 501(c)(3) organization producing plays, musicals, and other dramatic performances) for section 185.070.

headings.title: Program administration, eligibility oversight, and application fees
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 3 text and 2019 history note. Assigns council administration of the Missouri historical theater program, including application forms, timelines, announcements, ongoing eligibility monitoring, and an application fee covering administration and subsection 5 certificate costs.

headings.title: Criteria for historical theater designation
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 4 including lead-in and subdivisions (1)-(5) plus 2019 history note. Lists five council evaluation criteria: 501(c)(3) nonprofit status, at least three public shows annually, tourism contribution, arts promotion in the community and Missouri, and at least fifty years of operation.

headings.title: Certificates for designated historical theaters
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 5 text and 2019 history note. Provides that theaters selected for the state historical theater designation receive a framing-suitable certificate from the council.

headings.title: Annual list provided to the division of tourism
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 6 text and 2019 history note. Requires the council annually to provide a list of designated state historical theaters to the division of tourism.

headings.title: Department rulemaking authority, chapter 536, and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 7 text and 2019 history note (noting archived text assigns permissive rulemaking to the director of the department of economic development with council advice, whereas section 185.010's cross-reference notes council transfer to the lieutenant governor under 620.010). Includes chapter 536 / section 536.028 compliance and nonseverability with post-August 28, 2019 voidness clause.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 185.070 (subsections 1-7 and all subdivisions), 2019 history note, and neighboring section 185.010 cross-reference note; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked 501(c)(3)/50-year eligibility criteria, subsection 5 certificate cross-reference in subsection 3, literal archived rulemaking grant to the director of economic development in subsection 7 (retained faithfully alongside 185.010's section 620.010 transfer cross-reference), chapter 536/section 536.028 compliance, and post-August 28, 2019 nonseverability clause. Retained all seven drafted titles.

headings.title: Trust fund creation, trustees, investment, uses, and nonlapse
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 text and 1993-1996 history notes. Creates the Missouri Arts Council Trust Fund (funded by board transfers, section 143.183 transfers, and investment earnings), establishes its board of trustees with office-tied terms, provides for treasurer investment, restricts appropriated use to arts promotion and council administrative costs, and exempts fund moneys from section 33.080 transfer to general revenue.

headings.title: Support for activities highlighting African-American and minority contributions
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 text and 1993-1996 history notes. Directs the Missouri arts council to support and maintain activities demonstrating, exhibiting, or celebrating the contributions of African-Americans and other minorities. Reviewer broadened 'celebrating' to 'highlighting' to reflect all three statutory verbs (demonstrate, exhibit, or celebrate).

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 185.100 (subsections 1-2) and 1993-1996 history notes; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked section 143.183 transfer reference, board of trustees office-tied terms, treasurer investment, appropriation-subject use limits, and section 33.080 nonlapse clause. Revised subsection 2 title from 'celebrating' to 'highlighting' to cover all three statutory verbs ('demonstrate, exhibit, or celebrate'); retained subsection 1.
